cards.title: 💻 About Me
cards.content: I completed Bachelor of Technology (May 2026) in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning from Buddha Institute of Technology, Gorakhpur, affiliated with Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow. I am a passionate and strong interest with Python Developer, Full-Stack Developer, Backend Developer and Machine Learning Engineer. I am always eager to learn new tools & technology to enhance my skills, and develop user-friendly and impactful applications.

cards.title: 🎯 Career Objective
cards.content: To work in an organization where I can apply my knowledge and skills to contribute to organizational goals, deliver highquality results, and create value for the organization.
